item.title: Poll position: Where Trump stands among Americans as he faces the nation in primetime
item.summary: President Donald Trump's approval ratings have edged down in recent weeks, sinking further underwater as he faces the nation on Wednesday night to update Americans on the Iran war.

item.title: Iran's ceasefire push may be a 'cycle of deception,' analysts warn as shadowy figure gains power
item.summary: Iran's shadowy Ahmad Vahidi, a former Quds Force commander linked to deadly bombings abroad, is now more dominant than Iran's president or Khamenei's son, experts warn.

item.title: Iran fires back with flat denial after Trump claims Tehran requested ceasefire: 'False and baseless'
item.summary: President Donald Trump's social media statement that Iran asked for a ceasefire is "false and baseless," Iran's Foreign Ministry said Wednesday.

item.title: Mark Kelly sides with Hegseth on lifting Army pilots' suspension over Kid Rock flyover
item.summary: Sen. Mark Kelly said Wednesday he does not want Army pilots punished over a helicopter flyover at Kid Rock's Nashville mansion, agreeing with Secretary of War Pete Hegesth.

item.title: Former Fleetwood Mac guitarist Lindsey Buckingham attacked by alleged stalker: report
item.summary: Former Fleetwood Mac guitarist Lindsey Buckingham was reportedly attacked and doused with an unknown substance by a stalking suspect in Santa Monica.

item.title: Long-cold case shattered as DNA links suspect to savage attack, killing of young woman, investigators say
item.summary: DNA technology has linked Freddie Lee Granger Jr. to the 1984 rape and murder of Sandra Kaye Davis in Georgia, leading to his arrest 42 years later.

item.title: Pirro blasts DC Council for fueling teen violence, 'criminal chaos' as juvenile curfews set to expire
item.summary: U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro warns of rising teen violence, accusing the D.C. Council of fueling "criminal chaos" by letting juvenile curfews expire.

item.title: Banking tech data breach exposes 672K in ransomware attack
item.summary: Marquis says a ransomware attack exposed personal and financial data for 672,075 people, including Social Security numbers and bank account details.

item.title: Should you microdose Ozempic? Experts are split on risks vs benefits
item.summary: Microdosing GLP-1 drugs is trending on social media and supported by some doctors, but experts warn the practice lacks a standard protocol and may undermine weight-loss results.

item.title: Trump calls for second 'big, beautiful bill' to fund ICE on his desk by June 1
item.summary: Trump pushes Republicans to use budget reconciliation to fund ICE and border agents, setting a June 1 deadline to end the 47-day DHS shutdown.
